component.name: ImgConvert
component.summary: 本地优先的批量图片转换工具

description.p: Convert batches of JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images locally, and import SVG, static GIF, and BMP files, without uploading files.
Choose the input files, output format, and destination; ImgConvert performs the conversion on your device.

screenshot.caption: Batch conversion queue and output settings

description.p: Fixes Windows HEIC CI coverage for the shared decoded-image dimension guardrail and publishes the conversion-first direct packages.
Makes requested format conversion the default: larger outputs and lossy re-encodes are skipped only when their optional compression policies are enabled.
Fixes SVG conversions being incorrectly skipped by the larger-output safeguard and improves dialog loading and host file-picker resilience.
Publishes the verified Mac App Store candidate with the SVG, static GIF, BMP, privacy, and resource-safety improvements.
Adds SVG, static GIF, and BMP import, and hardens image resource limits and Mac App Store privacy safeguards.
Clarifies the local image-import purpose of the macOS Media Library permission and validates it in release artifacts.
Adds an in-app privacy and support entry point and clarifies Mac App Store privacy boundaries.
Removes unused update-related macOS automation from the Mac App Store build.
Adds safer output naming, configurable suffixes, output-folder authorization, and explicit source-overwrite protection.
Fixes Mac App Store sandbox output-folder access and clearly reports output permission failures.
Fixes Mac App Store startup stability and verifies the signed sandbox entitlements used for release builds.
Hardens release asset verification and preserves existing output files if a replacement write fails.
Keeps AUR package metadata synchronized with the official project website.
Improves conversion path handling and release reliability across supported platforms.
Normalizes AppImage launcher permissions for sandboxed catalog validation.
Includes complete AUR submission metadata in the downloadable release artifact.
Fixes Snap builds by sanitizing the GNOME SDK environment and enabling Tauri's embedded production frontend.
Provides the Rustup build dependency required by the Snapcraft Rust plugin on all supported architectures.
Aligns all Linux package builders with the Ubuntu 22.04 compatibility baseline and fixes tool detection on that baseline.
Adds strict Snap packaging, an Ubuntu 22.04 AppImageHub compatibility baseline, and reproducible AUR package metadata.
Improves release packaging and keeps image conversion local to the device.
